en.sayed-ali-raza: You were the army of a woman and in the command of a quadruped.
When it grumbled you responded, and when it was wounded (hamstrung) you fled away.
Your character is low and your pledge is broken. Your faith is hypocrisy. Your water is brackish.
He who stays with you is laden with sins and he who forsakes you secures Allāh’s mercy.
As though I see your mosque prominent, resembling the surface of a boat, while Allāh has sent chastisement from above and from below it and every one who is on it is drowned.
